assumptions: The climate path is a linear ramp from year 0 to the horizon. The ramp shape is assumed.
Absolute estimates are scenario comparisons. They are not a prediction of harvest, profit, or soil loss.
A cost the farmer did not enter was not treated as zero.
Farm rollup series are area-weighted averages of the field percentiles, not a new ensemble.
Sensitivity cells use the rain and temperature axis alone. Seasonal rain from the request is not added on that grid.

Station cross-check: CLOVERDALE EAST (ECCC climate identifier 1101708), 3.8 km from the site; paired POWER overlap 1992–2024. The headline station bias is POWER minus station mean temperature. The monthly rainfall comparison pairs POWER corrected total precipitation with ECCC TOTAL_RAIN; these differ because POWER precipitation may include frozen precipitation.

KPU's SoilGrids point has no values. Fields without a soil test use an assumed nearby SoilGrids proxy at 49.109, -122.639, about 470 m away; this is not a field measurement. Check it with a local soil test.
Current rotation uses the team's starting preset for fields without an entered rotation.
No SMAP seed is stored. A field moisture map was not produced.
Infiltration multipliers, heat and frost yield penalties, and the RUSLE C, P, and R stand-in are assumed. TODO(verify).
ICBM kY, kO, and h are the Andrén & Kätterer 1997 Table 1 values, not fitted at this farm. TODO(verify).
Nitrogen class rates and the pest return interval are assumed. TODO(verify) against a local extension guide.
Ky values used when the catalog is null are the FAO Paper 33 season totals reprinted in FAO Paper 66 Table 1.
